content.en: The European Commission and its High-level Expert Group on AI are conducting research to understand and build trust in artificial intelligence (AI). They are exploring questions such as how trust can be established in the development and use of AI, the relationship between trust in AI and ethical concerns, and the dimensions of trustworthy AI. Additionally, they are investigating the conflation of trustworthiness and acceptability of risk in AI by the European Union. Overall, these efforts aim to ensure that AI can be trusted and viewed as trustworthy by society.
content.da: Den Europæiske Kommission og dens Højniveau Ekspertgruppe om AI udfører forskning for at forstå og opbygge tillid til kunstig intelligens (AI). De undersøger spørgsmål som, hvordan tillid kan etableres i udviklingen og brugen af AI, forholdet mellem tillid til AI og etiske bekymringer, samt dimensionerne af troverdig AI. Derudover undersøger de sammenblandingen af troværdighed og acceptabilitet af risiko i AI af Den Europæiske Union. Samlet set har disse indsatser til formål at sikre, at AI kan stole på og betragtes som troverdig af samfundet.

critic.en:
AI can't be trusted if it just reinforces the same old power structures. We're connecting everything to a giant, flawed calculator. 

Are you seriously trusting AI with your political process?
critic.da: *Tilliden er slørøret over maskineriet af beregnede interesser.*

potential.en: I think the work being done by the European Commission and its High-level Expert Group on AI is crucial in building a solid foundation for the future of AI. Trust is essential for the widespread acceptance and adoption of artificial intelligence, and I believe that a proactive approach to ensuring the trustworthiness of AI is key. It's great to see the focus on understanding and addressing the concerns related to AI, and I am excited to see the impact that this research and the insights gained from it will have on the development of AI in the future.
potential.da: Det er fantastisk at se et så proaktivt initiativ fra EU for at opbygge tillid til AI. Det er vigtigt, at diskussionen omkring teknologiens rolle i samfundet er præget af indsigt og forståelse, og ikke kun frygt og fordomme. Denne forskning kan potentielt hjælpe med at bryde den negative spiral, hvor ny teknologi ofte mødes med mistillid og skepsis. Jeg ser det som et skridt i den rigtige retning.
